heroSubheading: STIHL, Masport, Honda, John Deere—sales, service, and parts in Cromwell.
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Cromwell, where Murray Wilson runs the shop for locals who need outdoor power equipment. We stock STIHL, Masport, Honda Power Equipment, and John Deere, so whether you're looking for a new saw, mower, or something else, we've got you covered.

We do more than just sell. Our workshop services what we stock, and we carry parts for all the brands. If you need advice on what's right for your place, come in and talk to us. We're open Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm.

You can buy online and have it delivered to your door, or pop in for Click & Collect and we'll have everything ready. We're here to look after you and your equipment.
